title: American Tradition 9000 Series
shortDesc: Premium insulated steel commercial doors with polyurethane insulation and tested U-factors as low as 0.081.
description:
The American Tradition 9000 Series is Haas Door's premium commercial steel line, pairing a handcrafted carriage-house look with serious commercial performance. Polyurethane insulation in 2-5/8" or 2" thicknesses delivers tested U-factors from 0.081 to 0.110.

With 42 available models and extensive customization, it's a standout choice for upscale commercial buildings that want curb appeal without giving up durability or efficiency.

title: Insulated Steel 800 Series
shortDesc: 3" thick insulated steel with a 0.089 U-factor, thermal break, and wind-load capability.
description:
The 800 Series is Haas Door's heavy-duty commercial steel door, built on 3"-thick sections with a tested 0.089 U-factor for strong thermal performance. It includes an air-infiltration seal and full thermal break.

Constructed from 26-gauge galvanized steel with wind-load capability and 19 color options, the 800 Series suits warehouses, distribution centers, and other demanding commercial applications.

title: Insulated Steel 2000 Series
shortDesc: 2" thick insulated steel with a 0.094 U-factor, full thermal break, and 26 color options.
description:
The commercial 2000 Series offers a strong balance of insulation and value on 2"-thick galvanized steel sections with a tested 0.094 U-factor, air-infiltration seal, and full thermal break.

With 26 color selections and wind-load options, it's a versatile everyday commercial door for a wide range of business and light-industrial buildings.

title: Insulated Steel 700 Series
shortDesc: 1-3/4" thick insulated steel with a 0.093 U-factor and full thermal break — a commercial value leader.
description:
The commercial 700 Series brings dependable insulated-steel performance at an approachable price. Sections are 1-3/4" thick with a tested 0.093 U-factor and full thermal break.

Available in 26 colors with wind-load capability, the 700 Series is a smart choice for commercial buildings that want comfort and durability without stepping up to the thickest sections.

title: Commercial Aluminum Series
shortDesc: Corrosion-resistant aluminum full-view doors (CA-320, CA-315, CA-110) with painted, anodized, and powder-coat finishes.
description:
Haas Door's Commercial Aluminum Series delivers bright, modern storefront looks in corrosion-resistant aluminum. The CA-320, CA-315, and CA-110 models offer diverse glass options plus solid-panel availability.

Finished in painted, anodized, or powder-coated options, these doors are ideal for restaurants, dealerships, and retail spaces that want a clean, contemporary aluminum-and-glass storefront.
